title: Options
summary: Sound, interface and graphics settings, from the menu or the title screen (⚙).
text:
**Options** is in the menu (☰, or Esc) and on the title screen (⚙). It remembers your choices in this browser. On the title screen it also picks the region NEW GAME lands in, and how the autopilot plays.

- **Sound**: sound and music on or off, and the volumes of everything, the music, the effects and the voices
- **Interface**: pause when you switch away, zoom toward the cursor, edge scrolling, keep the screen on (phones and tablets), performance stats
- **Accessibility**: **Interface size** makes text, buttons and panels bigger or smaller; **Reduce motion** stops camera shake, zoom blur and flickering text (it follows your device's own setting until you choose); the **Colour-blind palette** draws highlights, warnings, alerts and the placement preview in colours that stay distinct with any common colour vision
- **Graphics**: glow, anti-aliasing, shadows, detailed water, the terrain look, weather, dust and haze, lens flare, zoom blur and more. If a phone runs hot or slow, turn off glow and weather first

**Anti-aliasing** smooths jagged edges; tap it to step through the choices. **Auto** picks for your device (the box shows what it chose). **FXAA** is the cheapest but a little soft, **SMAA** is sharper for a little more, and **MSAA** is the smoothest and works the graphics chip hardest. Turning it **Off** with Glow off takes effect the next time the game starts

The menu's **Controls** (or ?) lists every key and touch gesture. Under **Change keys**, tap a key and press the one you'd rather use (the camera, view and number keys stay as they are); **Reset keys** puts them all back.
